response.overview: PRESSURE is a gritty suspense thriller centered on Malik Coleman, a man recently released from prison and placed on house arrest while trying to reclaim control of his life. But when he receives a mysterious caller begins directing his every move, Malik is pulled into a deadly chain of paranoia, revenge, and manipulation.  What starts as a personal threat quickly unravels into something much larger. Old street loyalties are tested, past betrayals resurface, and Malik finds himself trapped in a system where every decision feels rigged from the start. As the body count rises and the truth becomes harder to trust, Malik discovers that the people pulling the strings are far closer—and far more protected—than he ever imagined.  At its core, PRESSURE is a tense, street-level thriller about survival, corruption, and the illusion of second chances.
response.title: Pressure
